text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan isn't feeling well, so I
take her to
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oof. I'm just going to rest a bit.
I'm sure the
peppy Machan you know and love
will be with
you again soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Fwish. Scuffle, scuffle...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Agent Machan, reporting. Target
secured.

text_block_list.name: Boss
text_block_list.text:
Excellent work. Return to base on the
double.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, roger th—

text_block_list.name: Men in Black
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Machan!
You're not getting
away!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, looks like trouble.
I'm afraid I
can't allow myself to be caught,

however.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: After all, I am Machan—the best and most international spy alive.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black
text_block_list.text: ...Have you really thought this through?

text_block_list.name: Man in Black
text_block_list.text:
Spies belong in the shadows. The mark
of a good
spy is that no one remembers
they were ever
there at all.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black
text_block_list.text:
It's basically the complete opposite of
becoming
a global mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh... That's a valid point.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: But I don't care.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The world will know me as Machan the
beloved mascot. Which means no one
will suspect my
secret identity as the
world's best spy!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I think that sounds feasible!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, it sure does. Hehehe. Anyway, I've
got no
time to waste standing around
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Aston Machan comes back from
her rest, I
find her in great condition and
a surprisingly
good mood.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is an issue, yes... A spy that stands
out,
hmm...

text_block_list.name: Man in Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why we've been telling you to find
another
career... Well, it's too late now
anyway.
Take her away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huhhh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I'm not cut out to be a spy,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Aston Machan had a
stressful dream. That's the only
explanation for why she's still
struggling
after getting so much rest.
